question.text: Increasing order of solubility of AgCl in (i) $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}$, (ii) 1 M NaCl (aq.), (iii) $1 \mathrm{M}$ $\mathrm{CaCl}_2$ (aq.) and (iv) $1 \mathrm{M}$ $\mathrm{NaNO}_3$ (aq.) solution

solution.text:
$\text { In } \mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O} \text { solubility }=\sqrt{\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{sp}}}$
In 1 M NaCl and in $1 \mathrm{M} \mathrm{CaCl}_2$ more the [ $\mathrm{Cl}^{-}$] less is the solubility Hence $\mathrm{CaCl}_2 \lt \mathrm{NaCl} \lt \mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O} \lt \mathrm{NaNO}_3$
